scope: Native Windows x64 WARP; normal file-open route; production software backgrounds

protocol.balanced_block: 03: fresh profiler invocation per case; control/candidate/candidate/control

limitations: Two observations per arm per case on one machine; descriptive, not statistical or universal.
CPU is aggregate process CPU over the full burst/drain interval, not one-core CPU or latency.
Host nearest-rank p50/p95 cover only each measured root-frame range; not GPU completion or physical latency.
Frame counts and idle-hit proportions differ; wheel messages and presents are not one-to-one.
Earlier prose settle rejections in both arms remain rejected; no deadline relaxation or normalized-away drift.
Receipt is builder provenance, not cryptographic source attestation; raw private logs remain local.
